references.text: Lists Jesus' genealogy and mentions Joseph as the husband of Mary, of whom Jesus was born, providing context to Jesus' family background.
Mark gives a similar description of people's reaction to Jesus, mentioning his trade and family.
Luke also mentions Jesus' family in a similar setting, which helps confirm the identity of Jesus' immediate family.
John notes that not even Jesus' brothers believed in him, offering insight into the family dynamics and relationships.
Paul mentions James, Jesus' brother, as an important figure in the early church, underscoring the significance of Jesus' family for Christianity.
